fields.why: The Results rank 2021 current-use prevalence across grades 12, 10 and 8 (grade as an age proxy), an outcome measured in each of 3 SPD groups.
Grade stands for age; the sex comparison is a pair and does not enter groupwise.
The grade ranking carries no test across grades; the flagged CI-inversion tests are for male vs female PDs (a pair), so the mechanical flag is a false alarm.
